content.about: Solomon Islands is a Pacific country of nearly 1,000 islands. It has rainforests and coral lagoons. Many WWII wrecks lie in its waters. Shell money is a tradition.

standout.text: Marovo Lagoon is one of the largest saltwater lagoons in the world.

didYouKnow: Shell money is still used in ceremonies.
Iron Bottom Sound has many shipwrecks.
